## Authority and trust review

- [ ] No claim, company, campaign, incentive, statistic, source, reviewer, or verification state was invented.
- [ ] New public content answers a documented search intent and passes the publication authority gate.
- [ ] Canonical ownership, topic-cluster membership, entity relationships, sources, dates, and review owners are explicit.
- [ ] Sample, estimated, stale, future, and verified states are distinguishable.

## Product quality review

- [ ] Internal links create useful continuation paths and introduce no dead end.
- [ ] Structured data describes visible page content only.
- [ ] Keyboard, mobile, light/dark, reduced-motion, and error states were considered.
- [ ] Performance, privacy, security, and logging risks were assessed.
